scriptData.label: Add granted Talents, Traits and items

description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Long sharp bone shards protrude from your skin. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.BqPZn6q3VHn9HUrW]{Horns} SB+1 (Spines) Creature Trait and can use your spines to ram an enemy, trying to impale them. Roll 1d10: on a roll of 9 the spines are retractable enabling you to hide them; on a roll of 10 they are venomous and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.gFkRm9wS65qe18Xv]{Venom (Average)} Creature Trait. Each additional time you gain this mutation you may choose one of the following; the retractable ability, the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.gFkRm9wS65qe18Xv]{Venom (Average)} Creature Trait, or add +1 Damage.
